classification_rules.LOCAL_ATOMIC_CANDIDATE: All legs + lender operations settle within one chain transaction or Sui PTB; exact state, amount quotes, capacity, repayment and simulation required.
classification_rules.CONDITIONAL_HYPEREDGE: Mint/burn, redemption, claim, vault, liquidation, auction or rights transformation; immediate caller rights and same-transaction postconditions must be proven.
classification_rules.HEDGED_NON_ATOMIC: Requires inventory, CEX hedge, bridge, funding interval, cooldown or multi-period carry.
classification_rules.SIGNAL_ONLY: External reference, oracle, CEX, bridge or event signal that may trigger a local scan but is not a local liquidity leg.
classification_rules.CONTROL_PLANE: Sizing, lender selection, portfolio, scheduler, conflict or observability; not an alpha opportunity by itself.
classification_rules.CROSS_CUTTING_GUARD: Identity, exact math, stale state, token extension, source quality or risk control; not a strategy by itself.

global_gates: Never treat quote routers as independent underlying liquidity.
Never treat TVL, displayed book depth, admin flags or documentation fee as current flash capacity.
Re-quote every nonlinear amount candidate; do not scale one quote by a multiplier.
All strategy candidates must be traceable to canonical identity, source hashes, coherent state generation and exact economic costs.
Unknown values remain UNKNOWN; no default zero for fee, capacity, transfer tax, rent, gas or redemption delay.
Research universe remains broad; execution universe is a separately gated subset.
Balancer generic pools are not active routes after BIP-928 withdrawals-only transition; verify per-pool v3 exception before routing.
Sui JSON-RPC mainnet is disabled; new Sui data readers use gRPC/GraphQL/checkpoints.
DefiLlama free yield endpoint and GeckoTerminal/CoinGecko current quotas are subject to changed commercial terms.
No wallet/account creation, signing, sending, borrowing, spending or production promotion.
